meta.counts_blurb: Average bikes per day at the busiest DfT traffic count points inside York & North Yorkshire, 2021–25 (only points manually counted at least once). Most are single weekday counts on main roads, so weekend leisure riding is undercounted and off-road paths are not covered. Leeds is the only area here with open data from automatic council counters.
